items.title: Python and Jupyter Notebooks for Machine Learning

source_refs.note: 'Python and Jupyter Notebooks for Machine Learning' under topic 6.10, as printed (PDF 89, printed 85).

blocks.text: Python is a popular programming language for machine learning. It has many useful libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and others Python supports data analysis and modeling. Jupyter notebooks provide an interactive environment. Code and results appear together on Jupyter notebook. This helps learning and testing the code on an interactive Integrated Development Environment (IDE). Python supports advanced machine learning and is widely used in industry.
